$comment: Frictionless Table Schema (https://specs.frictionlessdata.io/table-schema/). Tab-separated, UTF-8, one header row; columns appear in this order.
name: qc_modifications
title: qc.modifications.tsv
description: Occupancy of every searched variable modification: one row per input file and searched definition, then the same rows for the whole run under `total`. Written only when the search has at least one variable modification. Also written to run-summary.json under qc.modifications.

fields.name: file
fields.description: Spectrum file name, or `total` for the rows covering all files.

fields.name: site_rule
fields.description: The definition's site rule as a configuration key writes it, for example `M`, `peptide_n_term` or `internal_residue:K`. A definition configured at several site rules has one row per rule.

fields.name: mass
fields.description: Monoisotopic mass of the definition, six decimals.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The definition's configured name; empty for a definition written as a bare mass.

fields.name: search_mode
fields.description: `database` for a definition expanded into the fragment index, `mass_offset` for one tested at search time.

fields.name: peptidoforms
fields.description: Distinct confident target peptidoforms with at least one site this rule selects.

fields.name: modified_peptidoforms
fields.description: Those peptidoforms carrying this definition on at least one of those sites.

fields.name: eligible_sites
fields.description: Sites this rule selects, summed over `peptidoforms`.

fields.name: occupancy_pct
fields.description: `modified_sites` as a percent of `eligible_sites`, three decimals; zero when no site is eligible.
